'''Kazarak''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mahrusha sector/Legends|Mahrusha sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
This planet served as the base of operations for a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] ring that operated in the Mahrusha sector during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
